properties.project_name: Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the size in the notes ('161,757 sq ft plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space') was not found in any readable source and was replaced by SFGate's 'nearly 164,000-square-foot' with the conflict noted; the 2006 groundbreaking and June 2009 opening are now also cited to A History of UCSF and SFGate (added to source_doc_urls) because the UCSF press release returned 403. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in the repo's DataSF parcels copy) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.'; notes: 'About 164,000 sq ft (SFGate, May 2009; the architect's page gives a conflicting 174,020 with a mislabelled unit), five stories, two interlocking L-shaped wings (wet labs and PI/fellow offices). Architect Rafael Viñoly Architects. Broke ground 2006 (A History of UCSF); grand opening June 2009 (UCSF's press release, not readable in the 2026-09 audit; SFGate, May 31, 2009: 'officially opens Tuesday').'. 2026-10-12 TEXT CORRECTION (no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): notes presented the June 2009 grand opening as an event; its UCSF release returns HTTP 403 and the readable SFGate article of May 31, 2009 is from before it. notes now say the month is supported by Wikipedia and SFGate and the day is unconfirmed. 2026-10-12 TEXT CORRECTION (no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): accuracy_caveat no longer calls the OpenStreetMap footprint 'surveyed' (OSM is volunteer-mapped; this way carries no source tag) and its example parcel was replaced: lot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd) does not contain this building, which lies in active lot 8711509, shared with the Hearst Tower, North and West housing buildings (8711507 is 12.2 acres by outline but 13.1 acres by its roll lot_area; 8711509 is 12.2 acres by outline and 12.1 by its roll lot_area of 528,539 sq ft).
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- OpenStreetMap building footprint (crowd-mapped, not an official survey), not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (in DataSF's Assessor parcel data the active lot 8711509 is about 12.2 acres by its drawn outline (the Assessor roll lists it at 555 Mission Bay Blvd with a lot area of 528,539 sq ft, about 12.1 acres) and contains this building together with the Hearst Tower, North and West buildings), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: About 164,000 sq ft (SFGate, May 2009; the architect's page gives a conflicting 174,020 with a mislabelled unit), five stories, two interlocking L-shaped wings (wet labs and PI/fellow offices). Architect Rafael Viñoly Architects. Broke ground 2006 (A History of UCSF); opened June 2009 (Wikipedia: 'opened in June 2009'; SFGate, May 31, 2009, before the event: 'officially opens Tuesday'); UCSF's grand-opening press release could not be read, so the day is unconfirmed.
